column1: # Browser cases that the hosted runner does not run (tests/m2/local_only.py). Lines that start with # are comments.
# Rule: a case may be marked local-only in .github/workflows/ci.yml (M2_LOCAL_ONLY_CASES) only with a row here.
# <gate-runner> is the gate-runner folder of the studio evidence store: target/mc-evidence/gate-runner/ in the main
# checkout. The file mc_headed_v6.sh is kept there with exec_in_lane_v4.py. No row may hold an absolute path of one machine.
# Proof that the local gate ran: tests/m2/local-receipts.tsv, checked by `local_only.py --receipts --head <sha>`.
# That check is a step of the local gate and of the final MC regression. Hosted CI never runs it.

column2: needs a real GPU: on the hosted software renderer each window shows a new tick only every 28 ticks, the two are 16 ticks out of phase, and they share no tick (run 43214215645: 0 shared ticks in 1651 polls)
